$comment: TWO-STEP stories in which one step MULTIPLIES or DIVIDES (Year pages T, 2026-11-14; 3.OA.D.8; facts within 100): M1 times then plus · M2 times then minus · M3 divide then plus · M4 plus then divide · M5 minus then divide. The words for packs, baskets and fair sharing are those of the reviewed one-step stories (word-problems-levelset.json: mul, share). Slots: {n1} {n2} {n3} are the numbers in the order of the two number sentences (n1 ○ n2 = s, s ○ n3 = answer), {noun}, {name}, {Q} = how many, agreeing (es, pt, it). A name is never inflected and takes no pronoun that shows a gender. The thing is named after a number and after 'how many' only; in M1 it is named again after the number at home ("already has 19" read as 19 packs: native reader). Read by a native reader (2026-11-14). Only the two-step page with multiplying and dividing reads this file. M4 never ends its first sentence in a numeral before the number of children (de, nl, sv, fi: "16. 7 Kinder" read as a date).
